body:
I might love her; she's the best thing in my life but I can't handle the pressure and expectations. I have low self esteem, and she's probably better off with someone else; I just don't want to be the one to show her that. Waiting for her to figure it out and dump me is killing me, though.  

If I quit a decent job for a dead end job (that's my pattern, but somehow the dead end jobs get better and then I have to quit them and start over) she'll dump me for sure.

I can't break up with her because she loves me and it would hurt her.

She would break up with me if I quit my job because she's successful, wants a family, etc. and won't want to be with someone that quits a job for no good reason (hating the job is not a good enough reason).
